case.title: Fabricated enumerator interview of 330 s, otherwise clean, fires

submissions.open_text: The church borehole charges five shillings per jerrycan and opens at seven.
Children fetch from the stream after school, and diarrhoea cases rose.

case.why: A fabricator keeps every other signal clean: daytime capture, a point inside Nyalenda, varied answers, unique text, its own device. They pad the duration to 5.5 minutes, well above the 3-minute participant minimum but far below the 12-minute (720 s) enumerator minimum. too_fast must fire because E02 is an enumerator. Three wrong implementations would let ivy pass. One applies a single global floor of 180 s. Another looks up kind incorrectly. A third compares duration_sec against the raw minute value 12, which no realistic interview is below. Other checks are quiet: there are 2 submissions only. Both points are inside Nyalenda. The times are 10:50 and 13:30 local. The texts share no near-duplicate wording. There is no voice note.
